summary: Iter 100 P0 routing-bugs regression — 8/8 backend tests PASSED against preview URL, frontend smoke-verified. Verified: (1) finance journal list returns 48 rows, (2) POST /api/finance/journal hydrates account_code/account_name when caller omits them, (3) POST /api/finance/transfers returns 400 when location_id missing and 200 when present, (4) /api/chat/users returns 4 users including 2 admin-tier peers (visible across campuses despite lacking location_id), (5) /api/admin/users/directory returns 5 users (>=1 admin) and search=admin filter still works, (6) /api/chat/conversations responds 200 (ghost-filter clause in place), (7) auth/me works. Frontend visually verified: campus switcher lists all 4 sub-locations (58:12 Global Central, Kampala East, Entebbe Campus, Jinja Campus) and is selectable; Finance page loads (Overview/Journal/Review Queue/Chart of Accounts/Reports/Budgets/Dept P&L tabs) with Record expense / Record income / Record transfer buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: chat.py list_chat_users builds a large $or/$and query — fine functionally, but the STAFF_ROLES list is duplicated between chat.py and admin.py; consider centralising in deps.py to avoid drift.

TransferDialog frontend was not exercised end-to-end via Playwright due to campus-switcher aria-haspopup ambiguity with the language picker; consider adding data-testid="campus-switcher-trigger" and data-testid="transfer-location-picker" for reliable e2e.

Restricted-location isolation could not be exercised (seed contains no explicit restricted location marker); recommend adding a seeded restricted location so future regression can cover the leak path.

success_rate.frontend: smoke-verified (login, campus switcher, finance page load)

seed_data_creation: Test JE(s) posted with description prefix TEST_split_hydrate_* and TEST_transfer_* — safe to leave, they are balanced legitimate entries in 2026-01-15 period.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file /app/backend/tests/test_iter100_p0_bugs.py covers the P0 routing fixes for iteration 344e. It reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env or falls back to /app/frontend/.env. Campus switcher uses `button[aria-haspopup]` which also matches the language selector; scope with a data-testid or the sidebar campus button. Restricted-location isolation was NOT tested (no restricted seed). Scheduler event-to-shift auto-time was not exercised in this run — recommend a follow-up frontend Playwright covering VolunteerSchedulingPage.
rca of the issue: N/A — fixes verified. Journal cross-tab refresh is code-only (dataEvents.emit finance-changed) and cannot be asserted from the API layer; the visual smoke on the Overview → Journal navigation shows both tabs populate and the count is consistent with the backend (48 rows returned by GET).
